faqs.question: What is involved in web development for UAE businesses?
faqs.answer: A typical project includes discovery, UX design, development on a modern stack, SEO setup, testing and launch. Ongoing optimisation helps maintain speed, security and search visibility.

faqs.question: Which technologies work best for UAE business websites?
faqs.answer: Next.js and React are popular for performance, SEO and flexibility. The right choice depends on your integrations, content workflow and long-term growth plans.

faqs.question: How long does it take to build a business website in the UAE?
faqs.answer: Timelines depend on scope. A focused marketing site may launch in weeks, while larger platforms with custom features require more planning. Clear requirements and agile delivery reduce delays.
